witnesses.exact_snippet:
Let \(X_0\) be smooth of finite type over \(\mathbb F_q\), let \(\ell\) be invertible on it, and let \(\mathcal F_0\) be a lisse pure sheaf of weight \(n\). Put

\[
X=X_0\otimes_{\mathbb F_q}\overline{\mathbb F}_q,
\]

and let \(\mathcal F\) be the pulled-back sheaf.

There is the canonical Frobenius-equivariant comparison

\[
c_i:
H_c^i(X,\mathcal F)\longrightarrow H^i(X,\mathcal F).
\]

Deligne proves

\[
\boxed{
I^i:=\operatorname{im}(c_i)
\quad\text{is pure of weight }n+i.
}
\]

The maps

\[
H_c^i(X,\mathcal F)\twoheadrightarrow I^i
\hookrightarrow H^i(X,\mathcal F)
\]
